title: Clean wire
tagline: Rebuild a messy model-made wire with fewer edges and control points: tangent stretches become one spline each, real corners stay corners, lines and arcs pass through exactly.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: Model-made wires come out correct but messy: slivers a tenth of a millimetre long, 0.4 deg kinks, heavy rational splines -- and lofts and fills through them wiggle or fail. Native Approximate samples 200 fixed points and ignores corners. Clean wire rebuilds the wire run by run.
useWhen: A wire feeds a loft, fill or driven offset
It has slivers or near-tangent kinks
You want a lighter curve that stays within 0.01 mm
slides.caption: SW_SHELF after Clean wire (Auto): 13 runs, max deviation 0.009 mm.

points.head: Tangent, near, corner
points.body: Under 0.57 deg: merged. Under the corner angle (3 deg): merged if 'make tangent' is on. Larger: a corner, kept.

points.head: Slivers (< 0.5 mm)
points.body: Judged by their own two joints: absorbed next to a tangent joint, kept as a chamfer between two corners.

points.head: Lines and arcs
points.body: A real line or arc passes through unchanged; arcs stay sketch arcs, so Onshape shows their radius.

points.head: Spacing from the tolerance
points.body: s = sqrt(4 tol / kappa): the chord between samples misses the curve by half the tolerance.

points.head: No edge skipped
points.body: 3 to 200 samples per edge, 0.05 to 10 mm apart -- a sliver still gets its samples.

points.head: Exact end tangents
points.body: Each fit starts and ends on the true tangent, so runs join smoothly.

slides.head: The SW_SHELF wire as the model makes it: 17 edges (plan view, ticks at the joints)
slides.body: Several short pieces and near-tangent joints -- each a place a loft or offset can wiggle.

slides.title: Example: after
slides.head: Clean wire (Auto), default settings: 13 runs, max deviation 0.009 mm
slides.body: Tangent stretches refitted as one spline each, the real corners kept, lines and arcs copied exactly.

items.head: Start with Auto
items.body: Check the Runs list; switch to Manual (Auto-populate) only to override a run.

items.head: Reference the body or its keys
items.body: Never the result's edge ids: they change whenever a run changes.

items.head: Manual groups go stale
items.body: They point at the source's edges; after an upstream renumbering, Auto-populate again.
